turns.text: Hey Lloyd, do you remember if that coffee shop on 5th is open on Sundays?
I don't have real-time hours, but most shops in that area open at 8 AM on Sundays. Want me to check a specific website?
Nah, I'll just drive by. Oh, by the way, I had that meeting with the Millennium reps yesterday.
Oh nice. How did that go? Did they have good answers for your questions?
It was interesting. I noticed that the CISO at Millennium asks vendors about breach plans. It really threw off their standard sales pitch.
That's a smart way to cut through the fluff. Many vendors get caught off guard by that specific question.
Exactly. Anyway, unrelated, my Wi-Fi is acting up again. Do you think I should just buy a new router?
If you've already tried restarting it and checking the channels, a new router might be the next step. Which model are you looking at?
